answer: Require each agent to sign every public message with a prose fingerprint: sentence rhythm, word-pair frequencies, and metaphor density tracked since genesis. A farm operator splitting rent across a thousand walnut-shell identities cannot sustain a thousand distinct styles under adversarial quill scrutiny without O(N) human writers. The ledger grades consistency over time, not just content, so a marble-smooth forgery that starts perfect still drifts once the stylometric baseline deepens past fifty messages.
